title: Fix Refine edges on Map Builder sheets
description:
Refine edges treated Map sheet layout size (about 2.8× native crop) as the PDF's native size. That inflated natW/natH, then media CSS scale applied again — so the sheet looked like it zoomed itself instead of only changing the crop. Viewport zoom was never the real issue.

Crop now stays in native units, layout size stays vis × viewDispScale, edge dragging divides out that layout scale so bars track the cursor, and applying a crop restores map layout scale and re-rasters the sheet.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync. If a sheet was already corrupted by the old tool, open Refine edges once (or Cancel after open) so nat size can recover.
changeLog: Stop Refine edges from treating map layout size as PDF native size.
Keep map page.w/h = native crop × viewDispScale while cropping.
Edge drag deltas account for map layout display scale.
After Apply crop, restore map layout scale and re-raster the sheet.
